name: How do developers determine pre-construction unit pricing?

mainEntity.name: How do developers determine pre-construction unit pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Developers price pre-construction units based on factors such as floor level, views, square footage, specific floor plans, and market demand. Units on higher floors or with desirable views (e.g., oceanfront in Sunny Isles Beach) often command higher prices. Pricing strategies can also reflect the overall construction costs, developer reputation, and current real estate market conditions in the region. Understanding these variables helps you evaluate the value proposition of different units.
acceptedAnswer.description: Unit pricing is based on floor level, views, size, floor plan, and market demand, with desirable features often increasing the cost.
